title: Talk it through 1.5
role: Account manager checking what a client said and confirming it by paraphrase
can_do: I can report what someone said with the right verbs and tenses.
I can confirm my understanding by paraphrasing.

nodes.partner_line: As I said, the supplier will cover the extra cost.
nodes.translation: Como dije, el proveedor cubrirá el costo adicional.

options.text: So, if I understand you correctly, the supplier will pay the difference?
Let me check that I have understood: the extra cost is not ours?
In other words, the supplier takes responsibility for the extra charge?

nodes.partner_line: Exactly. And what did the director tell you yesterday?
nodes.translation: Exacto. ¿Y qué le dijo ayer la directora?
nodes.model_reply: She said that the meeting would start at nine.

nodes.partner_line: Did she say anything about the budget?

options.text: She mentioned that it had been approved.
She pointed out that we could not exceed it.
She asked me whether we had checked it again.

nodes.partner_line: Sorry, I did not catch that. Could you say it again?

options.text: Of course. I said that the budget had been approved.
Certainly. What I meant was that we had enough funds.
Let me put it another way: there is no problem with the money.

nodes.partner_line: So you are saying the project can start next week?
nodes.translation: ¿Entonces dice que el proyecto puede comenzar la próxima semana?

options.text: Yes, that is exactly what I meant.
Yes, provided the contract is signed first.
Almost. It can start once the permit arrives.

nodes.partner_line: Thank you for clarifying. I will inform the team.
nodes.translation: Gracias por aclararlo. Informaré al equipo.

options.text: Thank you. Please tell them it is only provisional.
Great. Let me know if they have any questions.
Perfect. I will send a written summary as well.
